description: Defines the VtigerCRMObject class which provides methods for interacting with CRM entities, including create, read, update, delete, and utility functions for object management within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VtigerCRMObject
classes.description: A class for managing CRM entities, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and utility functions for handling module objects within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: VtigerCRMObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a module credential, either as an ID or name.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the module class instance.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads entity info from the database for a given ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity with provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing entity with provided data.

methods.name: revise
methods.description: Reads and updates an entity, fixing UTF-8 issues.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the column fields of the current instance.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an entity exists in the database.

methods.name: getSEType
methods.description: Retrieves the setype of an entity.
